cohort: 416,386 nulliparous women with spontaneous onset of labor, ≥37 weeks of gestation and singleton infants with a cephalic presentation
finding: Oxytocin augmentation in nulliparous women with epidural analgesia is associated with a reduced risk of cesarean section in labor with spontaneous onset.
mod_finding: This study found that oxytocin augmentation during labor in nulliparous women with epidural analgesia was associated with a reduced risk of cesarean section.
